hooks.name: player_totem
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge's LivingUseTotemEvent can cancel the save; this hook only listens. Bukkit's EntityResurrectEvent)

rust_summary: a totem of undying saving a player (`native_player_totem`).
doc_summary: a totem saving a player: `native_player_totem(player, name)` is heard for a server player whose hurt would have killed them and whose totem fired (`LivingEntity.checkTotemDeathProtection`, Bukkit's `EntityResurrectEvent`), just before the totem is used up. Listen only. The player's state is swapped in. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_player_totem@`.
